profile.title: M.Sc. Computer Science Student
profile.headline: Soon-to-be Computer Science Graduate with a background in Conga & Salesforce Consulting (and Development) along with operational experience in the Sales and Revenue Lifecycle. Naturally, I am well-versed in the Quote-to-Cash process with sound business acumen & multiple industries' domain understanding, and am learning Data & Security Engineering along with modern Revenue Management and Operational tooling in the AI era.

projects.name: Salesforce native application for querying Salesforce Attachments and Files
projects.description:
A Lightning Web Component (LWC) built on the Salesforce platform that allows users to query and manage Attachments and Files directly from their Salesforce org, streamlining document handling and helping optimize org storage.

The app is packaged as an unlocked package which can be installed using the package ID.

projects.name: Data Analytics: Binary Classification prediction model
projects.description:
A binary classification model using Python and scikit-learn to predict likely insurance claims based on historical data.

It compares multiple algorithms to determine the most effective approach using False Negative Rate (FNR) as the evaluation metric, demonstrating practical machine learning and data analysis skills.

projects.name: Full Stack Task Manager
projects.description:
A basic task manager application built with FastAPI, Next.js, and PostgreSQL, featuring RESTful APIs for task management, a simple frontend interface for task organization and tracking, and a database to persist tasks.

The Next.js frontend is conveniently deployed to Vercel with a server component hiding the backend services. The backend lives on Railway and/or Render while the DB is a Supabase instance.

It was further refactored and decoupled into microservices deployed on AWS as a Lambda function with added user authentication and authorization.

experiences.summary:
I was tasked with supporting the platform migration of a CPQ solution from Salesforce Conga to the Conga Advantage Platform for an energy equipment manufacturer.

As part of the task, I received training on the Conga Advantage Platform and its features and was responsible for the translation of features from Salesforce Conga to the Advantage Platform and resolving issues with the migration along the way.

Also contributed to optimizing an integration module (reducing its runtime) between an external product configurator (that configures products and creates cart line items) and the cart in Salesforce (for pricing and subsequent downstream actions in their RevOps pipeline).

experiences.company: Tesla Eco Tech, P.V.E, Redline Games (Small Enterprises)
experiences.summary:
I was involved in the consulting, implementation, and adoption of digital solutions in business operations (mostly in the sales lifecycle) as well as IT support and administration (Windows PCs, networks, surveillance). This included setting up a CRM (HubSpot Free Edition: budget contraints) for lead/opportunity tracking and automations (Zapier) for alerts in the sales lifecycle.

There were many side projects, including, but not limited to, GTM strategies (Life Cycle Assessment of raw materials for recycling assisting the circular economy and expanding into new markets) and CLV (Customer Lifetime Value) analysis (adopting analytics tools like Google/Firebase Analytics for mobile games to estimate engagement and retention, and plan marketing strategies).

I kept in touch with the Salesforce ecosystem by learning SFDX and JavaScript for LWCs.

experiences.company: Conga (B2B SaaS, formerly known as Apttus)
experiences.summary:
I was tasked with providing technical consultation and supporting Conga product (CPQ, CLM, and Billing) implementations, typically for high-value clients (ACV > $10M, Sectors: Medical Equipment Manufacturer, Fintech, SaaS, Consumer Electronics, Energy: integrated Oil & Gas, Auto Insurance & Roadside Assistance, and more).

My work spanned multiple technologies as the Conga (then Apttus) product offerings were hosted on several platforms: Salesforce, Apttus Intelligence Cloud on Azure, and MS Dynamics. I was trained as an Apttus CPQ, CLM, and Billing Admin to help with the responsibilities of the role along with Salesforce platform administration because majority of the client base were using the Salesforce offering (a managed package on the AppExchange) while the other two platforms were slated for end-of-life shortly (at the time).

My work also included providing technical guidance on best practices for using the Conga Product Suite and ensuring that clients were able to fully leverage the capabilities of the suite.
